scope: Prospective Member 4 study design and host preflight; no new training measurements or deployed model

design.features: Existing eighteen configuration inputs; no device identity or trial outcomes as inputs
design.grouping: Whole workload families; goal/period/session variants of an identical workload cannot enter different splits
design.training_matrix: Each goal has every selected I2C speed and every selected SPI speed; both UART-enabled and disabled loads occur
design.calibration: Before labelled trials, collect one separate 60-second calibration per workload at the current 500 ms sensor interval. Retain complete journals, per-worker max elapsed/lateness and context hashes. Calibration is never a training/evaluation row.
design.sessions: Collect training families in session A; validation and test families in a later session B with the same firmware/wiring and renewed connection checks. Keep all repetitions of a family together. Do not inspect held-out labels until fitting is frozen.
baselines: Existing simple rule: choose longest candidate with interval + source_period <= goal

Calibrated timing rule: choose longest candidate with interval + ceil((target max_elapsed_us + target max_lateness_us)/1000) <= goal; maxima come only from the separate same-workload 500 ms calibration
design.baseline_limits: The calibrated rule is an empirical service-time estimate, not WCET, CPU utilization or a scheduling guarantee. Missing, reset, saturated or unhealthy calibration invalidates it; no zero-cost substitution.

before_collection: Confirm current USB board, exact running ELF, reviewed physical wiring and unchanged restored profile bytes
Generate a fresh manifest, identity and execution context for the chosen image; the preflight used an older retained manifest only for offline admission
Require at least five minutes of fresh radar reports with the phone app disconnected and no new timeout, framing, I/O or UART-overflow events; preserve failures and do not claim root cause fixed
Keep phone app disconnected, hardware stationary and observer cadence fixed throughout calibration and trials
Freeze calibration artifacts, baseline calculation, source snapshots and study hashes before exposing trial labels; verify an independent calibration is available for every workload
Check source/build allocation qualification and original-profile restoration before opening the collection session
run_policy: A healthy zero-target radar report is valid; no absence test is required
A complete run with goal or peer faults remains a negative example
Interrupted, reset or identity-changing runs are retained separately and block training; no retry until pass
Persistent or unexplained transport silence pauses subsequent scheduled trials for diagnosis; preserve every attempted run
release_criteria: Keep the existing protocol_gate criteria unchanged: no held-out violation, unnecessary abstention or regression against a passing simple-rule choice, and at least one safe coverage/interval gain
Additionally require at least one safe coverage/interval gain over the separately calibrated timing rule with no regression where that rule passes; report all family decisions and baseline failures
If timing rules already solve the cases, report lack of ML benefit; do not adjust gates or repeatedly search the revealed test set
No unseen-device accuracy claim without a supported peripheral type excluded from training
No deployment from this USB-only study; combined static-compliant wireless execution, target parity/resources/loaded latency and reviewed Desk integration remain required

software_checks.note: Existing full suite completed during the interrupted turn. Subsequent edits change design JSON/documentation only; the final design passed fresh offline admission/context/range/overlap checks.
